mapper.sql: FROM approval a JOIN approval_revision cr ON cr.approval_id = a.approval_id AND cr.revision_no = a.current_revision_no AND cr.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN employee drafter ON drafter.user_id = a.user_id JOIN block b ON b.block_id = a.block_id JOIN step st ON st.step_id = b.step_id JOIN project proj ON proj.project_id = st.project_id
mapper.select: SELECT al.approval_revision_id AS revisionId, al.user_id AS approverId, e.name AS approverName, al.sequence_no AS sequenceNo, al.status AS status FROM approval_line al JOIN employee e ON e.user_id = al.user_id WHERE al.approval_revision_id IN #{id} AND al.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY al.approval_revision_id, al.sequence_no
